description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which represents a basic logging system component capable of outputting log data to various targets. It declares a method println() for logging messages with different levels of detail, including optional exceptions.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system component that outputs log messages to one or more targets, potentially supporting chained logging infrastructure.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable object to the first LogNode in the chain.
